name: smart-context-trimming
description: Compacts long Bash test/build output to the original lines that matter (errors, failed tests, stack heads, summary), optionally widened by one TypeSafe Jev decision; raw log kept on disk. Default observe.

minLines.title: Min lines
minLines.description: Outputs shorter than this (and under minBytes) stay unchanged.

minBytes.title: Min bytes
minBytes.description: Outputs smaller than this (and under minLines) stay unchanged.

useJev.title: Use TypeSafe Jev
useJev.description: In enforce mode, ask Jev (OPENROUTER_API_KEY) which optional candidates to keep. Off = rules only, no network.

maxJevLatencyMs.title: Jev timeout (ms)
maxJevLatencyMs.description: Past this, the rule result is used.

minJevConfidence.title: Min Jev confidence
minJevConfidence.description: Below this, the rule result is used.

rawOutputTtlHours.title: Raw log TTL (hours)
rawOutputTtlHours.description: Older raw logs are emptied at session start.
